Y8-032.concept: A straight graph has a constant gradient; a quadratic bends.

Y9-020.concept: Direct proportion passes through (0,0); inverse has constant product.

GCSE-OPEN.context: A line can approach one value without including its endpoint. The filled dot is the actual value at the boundary.
